title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented Lipscomb study settings, from reservable library rooms and academic-building spaces to outdoor tables and restricted student lounges.

cards.title: Reserve a Room at Beaman
cards.subtitle: Small rooms for solo focus or groups of up to four
cards.notes: Reserve ahead for a defined work session, and keep voices measured because the rooms are not soundproof.
cards.short_summary: Bookable library rooms offer a contained setting for quiet work or a small-group assignment.
cards.evidence_claim: Beaman Library lets users reserve study rooms for up to four people and identifies them as suitable for group work or quiet study, while noting that they are not soundproof.
cards.access_notes: Advance reservation is available. Beaman Library primarily serves Lipscomb faculty, staff and students; visitors should carry a valid Lipscomb ID and present it if requested.

cards.title: Spread Out in Bennett
cards.subtitle: Open seating and smaller rooms in the campus center
cards.notes: Use the open areas for flexible work, or look for a smaller room when your assignment needs fewer distractions.
cards.short_summary: Bennett combines roomy common areas with smaller, more relaxed rooms for changing study needs.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb’s parent resources page recommends Bennett Campus Center for studying and specifically describes its open space and small, relaxed rooms.
cards.access_notes: Campus-building access may vary; Lipscomb states that student IDs provide access to select buildings. Check posted room availability before settling in.

cards.title: Find a Quiet Room in Ezell
cards.subtitle: Academic-building classrooms and study rooms
cards.notes: Check that a room is unscheduled, then use the larger layout for notes, laptops or collaborative review.
cards.short_summary: Ezell’s study rooms and classrooms provide a larger indoor option for focused academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb’s official parent resources page names the study rooms and classrooms in Ezell among its recommended campus study locations and describes them as larger, quiet spaces.
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to building access and room availability. Lipscomb IDs provide access to select classrooms and campus buildings.

cards.title: Set Up in Swang
cards.subtitle: Quiet rooms inside the business and technology building
cards.notes: Look for an available study room or classroom and choose this stop when a larger work surface will help.
cards.short_summary: Swang supplies an academic-building setting with quiet rooms suited to individual or shared work.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb’s official parent resources page recommends study rooms and classrooms in Swang and characterizes these academic-building options as larger, quiet spaces.
cards.access_notes: Room use depends on availability and authorized building access; verify that a classroom is available before using it.

cards.title: Review Notes in McFarland
cards.subtitle: Larger quiet rooms in the science center
cards.notes: Bring the material you need, confirm the room is available and use the larger space for problem sets or review.
cards.short_summary: McFarland offers a quieter academic-building alternative near Lipscomb’s science facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb’s parent resources page explicitly lists McFarland’s study rooms and classrooms among the campus’s larger, quiet study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Access to classrooms and research areas can be limited by authorization. Check that the selected room is open and unscheduled.

cards.title: Work Below Crisman
cards.subtitle: Lower-level rooms identified for quiet study
cards.notes: Head to the lower level, confirm an appropriate room is available and settle in for a focused work block.
cards.short_summary: The bottom of Crisman provides a specifically documented indoor option away from larger social areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb’s official parent resources page recommends the study rooms and classrooms at the bottom of Crisman as larger, quiet study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Administrative-building and room access may be limited. Confirm access and availability rather than assuming every lower-level room is open.

cards.title: Take the Work Outside at Bison Square
cards.subtitle: An outdoor campus square used for studying and events
cards.notes: Choose an outdoor seat when weather permits, and check the campus calendar before planning a long session.
cards.short_summary: Bison Square offers an open-air change of setting in a central, recognizable part of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb’s official visit page identifies Bison Square as a place where students may study for a test as well as attend campus events.
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor campus space. Weather and scheduled events can affect usability; consult current campus notices when planning a session.

cards.title: Study at the Honors House
cards.subtitle: Study and common areas reserved for the Honors community
cards.notes: If you belong to the Honors College, use its study areas for focused work or a session with program peers.
cards.short_summary: A converted house gives Honors students indoor and outdoor study areas with a residential feel.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb documents the Honors House as a multipurpose space for Honors students and says it includes classroom, study, common, kitchen and outdoor common areas.
cards.source_title: Honors College's new home debuts to campus in August
cards.access_notes: This space is associated with the Honors College and should not be treated as generally available. Confirm current access with Honors staff.

cards.title: Use the Veteran Resource Lounge
cards.subtitle: Tables, soft seating and an interactive whiteboard
cards.notes: Eligible students can choose a table for coursework or use the interactive whiteboard for visual problem-solving.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated lounge combines practical study tables, comfortable seating and presentation technology.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb describes the Student Veteran Resource Lounge as a dedicated place for student veterans to study and lists several tables, couches and chairs, and an interactive whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: The lounge is dedicated to student veterans and is located in a separate building behind Elam Hall. Contact Veteran Services for current access details.

cards.title: Build a Work Session in Fields
cards.subtitle: Flexible study and collaborative learning space
cards.notes: Use the flexible study area for engineering coursework or bring a project team when collaboration is the goal.
cards.short_summary: Fields pairs flexible student study space with collaborative learning and engineering facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb states that Fields Engineering Center provides collaborative learning spaces and flexible student study space alongside its engineering facilities.
cards.source_title: Moon landing, future of space exploration shaped by engineering
cards.access_notes: The university does not publish general access terms on the cited page. Confirm current building access and space availability with the College of Engineering.
